## isva-p01-v01 — C1

**SUMMARY.** The maker — him praised, one God, Maheśvara. Bodies bespeak conscious cause, distinct-arranged — pots, like atoms. Conscious-urged fragments and fixed-meaning fragments survive around gaps. In the varied, the conscious alone is marked, maker-wise, use-resolved. Function-yoked bodies and worlds hold distinct array, never from mere matter. Makers proved prove the Lord's act; variety-knowers cannot be lordless. Neither potter nor Lord shows agreement — opposition or unprovedness would follow. Merely showing conscious-only pervasion — by thesis-force, some wise one is understood.

*Rasa: vīra (confidence) of stated proof — The sthāyibhāva is exultation: the inference stated in full dress, dilemmatized, then answered minimally — bare showing suffices. The vyabhicāri is wonder that less proves more. Nyāya-confidence turned toward a conscious Lord.*
